logistics.format: Submission of proposal, work package documenting application of ITIL in real assignments, plus interview with assessment panel; no traditional written exam

formal: Must hold ITIL Expert (v3) or both ITIL 4 Managing Professional and ITIL 4 Strategic Leader
Minimum 5 years of relevant ITSM leadership / managerial / advisory experience

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded leadership experience, assessed work portfolio and peer interview support senior organizational direction beyond exam recall; its high cost and ITSM emphasis constrain direct technical-security interpretation.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A work portfolio, panel interview and verified ITSM leadership provide substantial evidence of senior delivery judgment. The expensive and nontechnical process limits its use for SOC hiring, but the documented assessment supports expert service-management placement.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded real-work portfolio, peer interview and five-year leadership requirement are meaningful applied evidence. I place it at professional for security advisory use because the assessed discipline is IT service management rather than broad senior security practice.
